events.title: [LOW] CVE-2026-116012 — Ghidra before 12.2 contains a numeric truncation vulnerability in PackedDecode::skipAttribute and skipAttributeRemaining in marshal.cc that
events.summary: (vendor/severity tags below are heuristic) Ghidra before 12.2 contains a numeric truncation vulnerability in PackedDecode::skipAttribute and skipAttributeRemaining in marshal.cc that stores 64-bit string lengths in 32-bit variables. Attackers can supply a crafted packed stream, such as a malicious .sla file, to inject attributes into the decompiler's input or crash the decompiler process.

claims.text: CVE-2026-116012 is rated 2.0 (low) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-116012 being exploited in the next 30 days at under 1%.

events.title: The tragic events of the past week have shown Australians who we are – and it’s a long way from our image of ourselves | Julianne Schultz
events.summary: How can we attempt to understand the climate in which the hideous alleged attack on Helen Haines occurred? Immediately after news of the alleged attack on Helen Haines was revealed, the prime minister and others were quick to say , this is not who we Australians are, this is not the way we behave . The data from the Australian federal police, Asio and the experience of individual MPs suggested this may in fact be what a disappointingly significant number of us have become over the past decade.
